item.title: Rescheduling an appointment
item.body: After you verify your account, the assistant can look up your upcoming appointments and offer open times with the same provider. A change is made only after you confirm the exact new date, time and time zone. Fees for late changes follow the terms of your service agreement and appear on your statement; the assistant does not waive fees. Scheduling help does not include choosing a provider for clinical reasons.
